title: Set up your card
summary: Your card is what people see when they open your drop. Set it up once; it takes about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Open the setup
steps.body: After you sign up, Home shows "Set up your card". Tap it. There are 3 short steps; tap Continue after each, and you can go back to any of them.

steps.title: Your business
steps.body: Add your business name, a short tagline, your category, and your state and city. People see these first, so keep the tagline short and clear, like "Facials and glow-ups since 2019".

steps.title: Your look
steps.body:
Add your logo (a square picture works best), pick your brand colour, and choose a background: your colour, a pattern, or a photo.

Tikka checks your colour so the writing on your card is always easy to read.

steps.title: How people reach you
steps.body:
Add the buttons on your card, like Chat on WhatsApp, Call or Directions. Add the services you offer if you like.

You also pick your free page address (usetikka.com/your-name) and the two code letters that start every Tikka code, like GS for Glow Studio.

steps.title: Save your card
steps.body: Tap "Save my card" at the bottom. Your card is ready, and you can change any of it later in Settings.

tips: Use a clear logo on a plain background. It shows small on phones.
You can come back and add services, hours and photos any time.
